image_description: A close-up view of a silver-colored metal breastplate (cuirass) displayed on a black mannequin torso. The armor features intricate vertical embossed floral or scrollwork patterns down the center and sides. It has a high collar, a horizontal slit near the neck, and visible attachment straps on the right side. The surface is metallic and reflective, showing highlights from studio lighting.
